## Codebase navigation

- For repository-wide questions, start with `graphify query "<question>"`.
- Use `graphify explain "<concept>"` for a focused component view and
  `graphify path "<A>" "<B>"` to trace relationships.
- Treat `graphify-out/graph.json` and `graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md` as
  navigation aids, then inspect source files before making or explaining changes.
- After changing code, run `graphify update .` to refresh the project graph.
